models.description: MiniMax 开源权重旗舰模型，融合编程、Agent 推理、原生文本与视觉多模态和工具使用能力；稀疏注意力架构适合大型代码库、长程 Agent 任务及长视频理解。
models.description_en: MiniMax's open-weights flagship combines coding, agentic reasoning, native text-and-vision multimodality, and tool use. Its Sparse Attention architecture is designed for large codebases, long-horizon agents, and long-video understanding.

models.description: Qwen3.5 原生视觉语言 Flash 模型，采用线性注意力与稀疏 MoE 结合的混合架构，支持文本、图片和视频输入，在推理效率、响应速度与多模态能力之间取得平衡。

notes: ZenMux 未披露知识截止日期。
最大输出取精确模型提供方公开的 max_completion_tokens。

models.description_en: Qwen3.5 Plus is a native vision-language model using a hybrid architecture that combines linear attention with sparse Mixture-of-Experts. It accepts text, image, file, and video input and focuses on stronger reasoning efficiency and broad text and multimodal performance.
